sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Campuses"."County" AS g, SUM("degrees"."Degrees") AS m1 FROM "degrees" JOIN "Campuses" ON "Campuses"."Id" = "degrees"."Campus" GROUP BY "Campuses"."County"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v") SELECT SUM("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s3"
why: total of degrees conferred per Campuses.County (additive)
gap to the all average of total of degrees conferred (all level)
